facts.title: The disability price tag
facts.description: Scope says disabled households face an average £1,095 a month in extra costs to have the same standard of living as non-disabled households.

facts.title: Disabled workers are paid less on average
facts.description: ONS reported a 12.7% disability pay gap in 2023: median hourly pay was £13.69 for disabled employees and £15.69 for non-disabled employees.

facts.title: A large disability employment gap remains
facts.description: DWP reported a 29.7 percentage-point disability employment gap in Q2 2025.

facts.title: Deafness and hearing loss affect millions
facts.description: RNID says more than 18 million people in the UK are deaf, have hearing loss or tinnitus — around 1 in 3 people.

facts.title: BSL users need accessible information
facts.description: A 2025 government report cited around 151,000 BSL users in the UK, including around 87,000 Deaf people.

facts.title: Disability benefits affect millions of households
facts.description: DWP recorded 5.2 million people claiming PIP or DLA under DWP policy ownership at August 2025.
